title: Russian drones enter Poland and NATO aircraft shoot some down
body:
On the night of 9 to 10 September 2025, drones entered Polish airspace from Belarus between about 23:30 and 06:45 CEST, after reportedly being launched from Russia. Polish prosecutors reported more than 30 unarmed military drones, while other estimates were about 21 and about 23. Investigators said the drones were decoys and carried no explosives.

Up to four drones were confirmed downed by allied forces, mostly by Dutch F-35s, and Polish F-16s also fired. Italy provided airborne early warning aircraft, Belgium provided an aerial tanker, and German Patriot systems were placed on high alert. A house in Wyryki was damaged, reportedly by an AMRAAM missile fired by a Polish F-16 that did not explode, and damage was also reported in Czosnowka. No casualties were reported.

Poland invoked Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty, and Prime Minister Donald Tusk said the drones posed a direct threat. Russia called the accusations groundless, and its representative at the United Nations said the drones could not have reached Polish territory from the Ukrainian front. Belarus said it had warned Poland and Lithuania that drones disrupted by electronic warfare in Ukraine were passing through its airspace.

NATO launched Operation Eastern Sentry on 12 September to protect its eastern flank, and Poland briefed the UN Security Council the same day. Russia and Belarus then held the Zapad 2025 exercises, and Poland closed its border with Belarus from 12 to 25 September.
